name: Unactivated private Studio run SQL proof
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'lib/client-hub-migration/owner-run-*'
      - 'docs/migration-review/owner-run-*'
      - 'docs/migration-review/owner-schema-proposal.sql'
      - 'scripts/migration-review/synthetic-owner-payload.json'
      - 'scripts/test-studio-owner-run-sql.cjs'
      - '.github/workflows/studio-owner-run-sql.yml'
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  isolated-sql:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    services:
      postgres:
        # PostgreSQL17.6 extension-bearing baseline reported clean for denial tests.
        # CI fixture only. No production credentials or project connection.
        image: public.ecr.aws/supabase/postgres:17.6.1.071
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: fictional-studio-run-only
          POSTGRES_DB: studio_run_proof
        ports:
          - 55440:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U supabase_admin -d studio_run_proof"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 24
      - name: Install isolated SQL test driver
        run: npm install --prefix /tmp/studio-run-sql-proof --no-save pg@8.16.3
      - name: Actual synthetic SQL atomicity and RLS checks
        env:
          STUDIO_RUN_PG_MODULE: /tmp/studio-run-sql-proof/node_modules/pg
        run: node scripts/test-studio-owner-run-sql.cjs
